## What's new in 4.0.0

A ground-up refresh: maps, redesigned search and selection, and a polished interface.

### New features
- **Location browsing** — Browse your photos on an interactive map by location.
- **Custom album thumbnails** — Set any photo as the cover for your albums.
- **Redesigned selection sheet** — Revamped selection actions with addons and select-all.
- **Redesigned search** — Rebuilt search experience with improved results and history.
- **List-based albums** — View your albums in a compact list layout.
- **Lock images** — Lock the current photo to prevent accidental swipes.

### Improvements
- **Improved vault playback** — Fixed encrypted video streaming for reliable playback.
- **UI refresh** — Polished interface with refined animations and layouts.

## What's new in 4.2.0

Album organization, image-to-image search, a mosaic layout and a full settings redesign.

### New features
- **Album groups** — Organize albums into collapsible groups.
- **Merge albums by name** — Automatically combine albums that share the same name.
- **Merge sub-folder albums** — Consolidate nested sub-folder albums into their parent.
- **Frame-accurate video seeking** — Precise video scrubbing with adjustable sensitivity.
- **Image-to-image search** — Find visually similar photos using any image as a query.
- **Mosaic grid view** — Dynamic mosaic tile layout for the timeline.
- **Collections** — Create custom albums by grouping photos from anywhere.
- **Configurable selection sheet** — Customize which actions appear and their order.
- **Granular grouping settings** — Fine-tune which similar photos are grouped together.
- **Optional AI models** — AI models can now be downloaded on demand instead of bundled.

### Improvements
- **Settings redesign** — Complete UI and UX overhaul for all settings screens.
- **Refreshed button style** — New unified button design used throughout the app.
- **Categories UI refresh** — Redesigned categories screen with improved navigation.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed video codec exhaustion, favorite button in timeline, and grouped media selection.

## What's new in 4.2.1

Casting, an auto-contrast beta and a vault overhaul.

### New features
- **FCast video casting** — Cast videos and images to devices on your local network.
- **Auto-contrast (Beta)** — Real-time luminance-based contrast enhancement in the viewer.
- **Right-align selection actions** — Move top action buttons to the right for easier one-handed use.
- **Vault overhaul** — Gate authentication, custom passwords, per-vault security, and a streamlined flow.
- **Offline WithML variant** — New build variant with AI models but without online features (maps, cloud, network).

### Bug fixes
- Fixed phantom selections, corrected setup permissions, and improved image loading.

## What's new in 4.2.2

A security-focused release: app sandboxing, encrypted storage and a private folder.

### New features
- **Security hardening** — App sandbox (targetSandboxVersion 2), encrypted storage, and isolated file processing.
- **Sandboxed image decoding** — HEIF, AVIF, and JXL images are decoded in isolated processes for exploit protection.
- **Isolated metadata parsing** — EXIF and metadata extraction runs in per-file sandbox processes.
- **Private folder** — Store sensitive files outside MediaStore via SAF, hidden behind a security gate.
- **Encrypted storage** — Encrypt app preferences (AES-256-GCM) and Room database (SQLCipher) at rest.

### Improvements
- **Persistent rescan tracking** — MediaStore rescan state is now persisted in the database across app restarts.
- **Various performance improvements** — Lazy per-album timeline flows, reduced recompositions in media viewer, optimized collection types and state management.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed slow AI classification, dark status bar icons, map intent crash, motion player leak, large batch copy crash, filename date fallback, and updated dependencies.

## What's new in 4.2.3

Timeline filtering, richer video playback and a smarter search.

### New features
- **Timeline filter** — Filter the timeline by media type, favorites, year, or album.
- **Animated format support** — Play animated AVIF, JXL, and APNG images alongside GIF.
- **Video subtitles** — Embedded and external subtitle track selection with bottom-sheet management.
- **Video pinch-to-zoom** — Pinch-to-zoom and double-tap-to-zoom during video playback.
- **Enhanced search** — Search through image descriptions, metadata text fields, and the inline timeline filter.
- **Album picker search** — Search bar in the copy/move album picker for quick album lookup.

### Improvements
- **Redesigned Trash & Favorites** — Refreshed layout, improved visual hierarchy, and smoother animations.
- **UX improvements** — Dismissible settings banners, bottom-sheet confirmations, and optimistic trash feedback.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed drag-selection tracking, metadata edit keyboard overlap, and preserved original dates when overriding edited photos.

## What's new in 4.3.0

Story cards, redesigned video controls and a much faster cold start.

### New features
- **Story cards** — Swipeable photo stories above the timeline with auto-advancing viewer and configurable card types.
- **Redesigned video controls** — Animated more-options popup replaces the tall stack of video control buttons.
- **Video auto-contrast** — Auto-contrast and adaptive colors now extend to the video options popup.

### Improvements
- **Faster cold startup** — Cold startup optimized from ~900 ms to ~350 ms with lazy keystore caching and deferred initialization.
- **Improved shared element transitions** — More accurate photo-to-viewer transitions with single stable registration and Long-based keys.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed move/copy album access with MANAGE_MEDIA, screen rotation reset on video exit, status bar sync, ClassCastException after unlock, grid realignment on back navigation, loading shimmer during startup, and empty-media padding.

## What's new in 5.0.0

The biggest release yet — cloud sync with Immich, backup & restore, new editor effects and a faster viewer pipeline.

### New features
- **Cloud sync & Immich** — Connect your self-hosted Immich server and browse remote photos in a unified timeline with people, map, and smart search.
- **Cloud photo backup** — Back up selected albums to your server with deduplication and Wi-Fi/cellular controls.
- **Backup & restore wizard** — Export and import settings, favorites, cloud configs, and vaults, with optional password encryption.
- **New editor effects & filters** — Posterize, Edges, Borders, Hue, black & white, and a one-tap Negative preset.
- **Flexible date grouping** — Group media by day, month, or year — configurable per screen.
- **Album sections** — Organize albums into collapsible Common, Apps, and Other sections.
- **Save motion photo as video** — Export the embedded clip from a motion photo as a standalone MP4.
- **Advanced Protection support** — Automatically hardens decoding and metadata isolation when Android Advanced Protection is on.
- **Location detail sheet** — Tap a photo's location to see a map preview with quick actions to open it in app or externally.

### Improvements
- **Better APNG & JXL** — Improved animated APNG playback and JPEG XL image support.
- **Performance & smoother scrolling** — Faster grid rendering, image loading paused while fast-scrolling, prefetching for flicker-free transitions, and a new Sketch-based viewer pipeline.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed panorama mirroring, background audio on focus loss, picker album thumbnails, file descriptor leaks, vault UX issues, duplicate-key crashes, and SD card copy/move destinations.

## What's new in 5.0.1

More image formats, faster decoding and steadier scrolling.

### New features
- **More image formats** — View PSD, JPEG 2000, TIFF, and SVG files in the timeline and viewer, each with crisp pinch-to-zoom.
- **Use system font** — A new display option switches the app over to your device's system font instead of the bundled typeface.

### Improvements
- **Faster HEIC & AVIF** — Hardware-accelerated HEIC/AVIF decoding with fixed AVIF color artifacts.
- **High-quality JXL zoom** — JPEG XL images now zoom sharply in the viewer through a dedicated region decoder.
- **Smoother video playback** — Video follows the media volume stream, zoom and pinch behave naturally on rotation, and the info section stays open when auto-hide fires.
- **Stable scrolling & navigation** — Timeline and settings scroll positions are preserved, and viewer exit transitions no longer break.

### Bug fixes
- Improved editor markup gestures and crop box interactions, fixed launch crash on null MediaStore columns, black screen after deleting in the standalone viewer, panorama compass and gyro on rotation, album cover mismatch, date-field text, scrubber near zero, widget self-healing, and updated Simplified Chinese translations.

## What's new in 5.0.2

Editor and viewer refinements, plus more reliable manual backups.

### Improvements
- **Editor fixes** — Markup text stays within the canvas, the crop box resizes from its handles without auto-zooming, and the adjustment scrubber keeps the value you set.
- **Smoother media viewer** — Swipe-to-dismiss triggers naturally, a second swipe no longer closes the app, the rotate button works after multiple turns, and the top bar and quick actions respond correctly while the info sheet is open.
- **Reliable manual backup** — Start backup and Upload now work even when Auto-sync is turned off.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed grouped video overlapping the controls and stretching when switching members, and View all metadata for photos opened from other apps.

## What's new in 5.0.3

A polish release focused on video metadata, faster private folders and a smoother viewer.

### New features
- **Richer video metadata** — iPhone HEVC .MOV files now show full QuickTime and EXIF details — camera make and model, lens, focal length and dates — instead of an empty sheet.
- **Faster private folders** — Private folder media now fills in progressively as it is discovered instead of staying blank until the whole folder is scanned.
- **Fix black video on hide** — A new Video Playback toggle re-binds the player surface so videos no longer black out when the system bars are shown or hidden (on by default for Samsung).

### Improvements
- **Smoother viewer** — Paddings, the info sheet and video controls adapt correctly on rotation, the timeline keeps its scroll position when you return, and the info panel no longer auto-hides mid-drag or gets stuck invisible.
- **Editor fixes** — Crop no longer zooms when dragged out of bounds, and markup hangs, undo of no-op adjustments, the rotate button and off-canvas text have all been fixed.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed hiding items to a vault from the selection sheet, View all metadata for images opened from other apps, a stuck pull-to-refresh spinner, the material navigation toggle flashing the screen, and secure camera reviews over the lockscreen.

## What's new in 5.1.0
Cloud Gallery 5.1.0 brings your local and remote libraries together, adds powerful on-device creative tools, and makes large, animated and HDR photos faster and sharper.

### New features
- **Multi-account cloud library** — Connect Immich, ownCloud, Nextcloud, WebDAV, SMB and NFS, choose backup destinations, monitor sync and keep media available offline.
- **On-device subject cutout** — Detect, refine, copy, share or save a subject with a transparent background, without uploading the photo.
- **People and face blur** — Scan and group faces locally, browse people, and blur detected faces in the editor.
- **RAW development** — Adjust RAW white balance, exposure, highlights, colour and demosaicing, then export JPEG, PNG or TIFF.
- **Full-resolution editing** — A tiled, memory-bounded pipeline preserves resolution and source format on large photos.
- **HDR HEIC viewing** — Native tiled decoding and Ultra HDR gain maps provide sharp, memory-safe zoom on supported displays.
- **Interactive photo map** — Browse thumbnail clusters, switch map appearance and open a unified location timeline.
- **Lossless metadata sanitization** — Remove sensitive metadata from supported images without recompressing their pixels.
- **Albums** — Play configurable slideshows, browse media-type albums and choose custom album covers.
- **Secure picker vaults** — Authenticate individual vaults and select safely across them.

### Improvements
- **Help & Tips** — Search all guidance with fuzzy matching, open quick actions and view real UI previews.
- **System-aware dates** — Date and time formats follow the device by default, with guidance for custom patterns.
- **Viewer quality** — GIF, animated WebP and APNG render at full resolution, while opening and swiping are smoother.
- **Pinned albums** — Choose tile or banner layouts with privacy-safe locked thumbnails.
- **Selection and navigation** — More accurate drag selection, stable counters and tap-again scroll-to-top navigation.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed images incorrectly identified as RAW or TIFF, plus JXL metadata and SVG rendering issues.
- Fixed private-folder move, delete, playback and refresh failures.
- Fixed editor save failures, stale previews and streamed overwrite safety.
- Fixed subject-cutout gesture, paging and cleanup issues.
- Fixed mosaic and smart-category grid crashes.
- Fixed picker back navigation and multi-account cloud selection actions.
